details:
This update for 389-ds fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-86344: incomplete LDAP messages sent in rapid succession can cause worker thread exhaustion (bsc#1284028).
- CVE-2026-86345: smuggled plaintext commands sent alongside StartTLS requests can cause response forgery and
  authentication bypasses (bsc#1284034).

Update to version 3.1.5~git31.cfa3971e9:

 * Issue 7919 - CVE-2026-86344 - Fix worker pool exhaustion via partial LDAP messages (DoS)
 * Issue 8001 - RFE - log total number of entries in each backend
 * Issue 8017 - Server can hang at shutdown after an aborted import (#8026)
 * Issue 7879 - Outbound SASL bind waits forever while holding krb5_lock (#7881) (#7924)
 * Issue 7827 - Preserve dsEntryDN case from DN cache (#7828) (#7958)
 * Issue 7806 - Preserve dsEntryDN case on modify (#7807) (#7968)
 * Issue 7877 - UI - add view raw entry action (#7878)
 * Issue 7915 - UI - Reindexing single attribute does not show progress in modal (#7916)
 * Issue 7953 - dsrate - should use server's ldif directory location (#7954)
 * Issue 7921 - Fix StartTLS plaintext buffer handling (#7922) (#7944)
 * Issue 7912 - dsidm role create-filtered ignores --nsrolefilter and forces an interactive prompt (#7913)
 * Issue 7908 - dsctl cockpit open-firewall --zone passes a malformed argument (#7909)
 * Issue 7905 - man: fix dropped line in 99user.ldif(5) example (#7906)
 * Issue 7742 - memory leak in schema replication (#7894)
 * Issue 7848 - Reject incomplete MD5 and GOST-YESCRYPT hashes (#7849)
 * Issue 7744 - memory leak in search referral handling (#7884)
 * Issue 7702 - memory leak in send_specific_attrs() (#7883)
 * Issue 7745 - memory leak in replication replica init (#7892)
 * Issue 4598 - Copy attribute syntax hashtables to each worker thread (#5693)
 * Issue 7835 - rdn can be NULL when passed to bdb_has_spaces() in bdb_upgradedn_producer()
 * Issue 7837 - importing ldif with entry with long attribute name and subtype causes stack-buffer-overflow (#7838)
 * Issue 6270 - heap-use-after-free with pwp dictionary path (#7791)
